description:
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
Superior-Union
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26002445
DOCKET NO. F00542826
PLAINTIFF – DEUTSCHE BANK NATIONAL TRUST COMPANY, AS TRUSTEE OF INDYMAC INDX MORTGAGE LOAN TRUST2005-AR6, MORTGAGE PASS-THROGH CERTIFICATES,SERIES 2005-AR6 UNDER THE POOLING AND SERVICING SGREEMENT DATED MARCH 1, 2005
DEFENDANTS- ABEL GONZALEZ; MRS. ABEL GONZALEZ, HIS WIFE; COUNTY OF MIDDLESEX
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public venue on
Wednesday THE 2nd DAY OF December 2026
between the hours of two and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 2:00 P.M. prevailing time at Warinanco Ice Skating Center, 1 Park Drive, Roselle, New Jersey 07203 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the town of PLAINFIELD, County of Union and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: LOT 7 BLOCK 212
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
1535 MYRTLE AVENUE PLAINFIELD, NJ 07063
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Union County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes: Dimensions: 49FT. X 114FT. IRR
Nearest Cross Street: EVERETT PL
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice by publication.
*Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by Plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interests remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so, the CulTent amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee or the Mortgagee's attorney.
** *If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The occupancy status of the property is: OCCUPIED BY OWNER.
Plaintiffs good faith estimate of its upset price is: $95,592.75
Subject to open trash in the amount of $1,634.84 plus penalties and costs.
File No.: 23-08935 FC03
